notes.title: Update [1.2] Performance and Stability
notes.content:
Features
[list]
    [*] Controls are now shown.
    [*] Added boxing Gloves to Boxer experience.
[/list]

Fixes
[list]
    [*] Major gains to performance
    [*] Fixed memory leak which appeared after long sessions
    [*] Fixed rare issue when Vive controller's reconnected, they may become 'stuck' together
[/list]

Known issues
[list]
    [*] Windows 7 is not currently supported, and will cause the headset to render grey
[/list]

notes.title: [Patch 1.1] Update with 'Look Selection' and Xbox and Keyboard input
notes.content:
Features
[list]
    [*]Look selection which now allows users without Vive controllers to interact with UI by looking at them
    [*]The Xbox controller's A button can now be used to 'click' on highlighted ui
    [*]The keyboard can now be used to 'click' by pressing the Space or Enter keys
    [*]Added support for returning to the menu using the Xbox controller's Start button
    [*]Added support for returning to the menu using the Escape key on the keyboard
    [*]Added warning message when SteamVR is not detected
[/list]

The next update will bring major performance improvements to reduce stuttering and latency.

BuildID: 1104106

notes.title: Known issue with Xbox Controllers
notes.content:
Hi all,

There is a known issue where users that are only using a Xbox controller for input will not be able to interact with the menu. We are working on a fix for this at the moment.

If you are using a Vive, we recommend using Vive controllers to point and select in the menu for the moment.
